# GEO report: brightside-dental **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 73/100, Good Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 18.25 ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. High = (18.25 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. The basics are in place: robots.txt, a sitemap, server-rendered pages and working links. Four things cost points: every canonical points at a staging host, `` has no `lang`, the contact page's structured data is invalid, and the Services page is hidden from search. All of these results are read from code. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Point canonicals at the real site (GEO-015) - **Why it matters:** A canonical tells search engines which address is the official one for a page. Yours all name a staging site, so engines may ignore your real pages. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small. Use `https://www.brightside-dental.example`, the origin in `geo.config.json` and your sitemap. - **Score after this:** 81/100 (20.25 ÷ 25). ### 2. Add `lang` to `` and a description to the Team page (GEO-012) - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells tools which language the page is in. The Team page also has no description, so its snippet is left to chance. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:2` and `src/team.njk:1-4` - **What the code says:** ``, and a front matter with `title: Meet the team` and no `description`. - **Size:** Small. Use `` and add a `description:` line to the Team page. - **Score after this:** 81/100 (20.25 ÷ 25). ### 3. Fix the broken structured data on Contact (GEO-004) - **Why it matters:** JSON-LD is a block of data that labels your business for machines. A trailing comma makes it invalid, so parsers will discard it. - **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10` - **What the code says:** `"telephone": "0113 496 0000", }` - **Size:** Small. Remove the trailing comma. - **Score after this:** 81/100 (20.25 ÷ 25). Doing all three gives 18.25 + 6 = 24.25 ÷ 25 = 97. Fixing item 4 below as well (services noindex) takes it to 100. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt valid | Clear | `src/robots.txt`, copied by `.eleventy.js:1` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | `src/robots.txt:1-2` `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /` | | GEO-014 | Pages indexable | Problem | `src/services.njk:5` `noindex: true`. 1 of 4 routes (3 × 3/4 = 2.25) | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own domain | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:8`, all 4 indexable routes | | GEO-003 | Content in server HTML | Clear | Eleventy static build | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD valid | Problem | `src/contact.njk:10`. 1 JSON-LD source found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap discoverable | Clear | `src/sitemap.xml`, `src/robots.txt:3` | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:2`, no `lang` on any route | | GEO-016 | Server-rendered links | Clear | `src/_includes/base.njk:12` | | GEO-017 | Snippet restrictions | Clear | Only `data-nosnippet` on one element (`src/contact.njk:8`), a scoped choice | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | The one `` has alt (`src/index.njk:8`). Nav links have text | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt | Not scored | Absent | | GEO-102 | App structured data | Not scored | Not an app | ## Other problems found - **Services page is noindexed but listed in the sitemap and navigation (GEO-014):** `src/services.njk:5` has `noindex: true`. This is probably a mistake for your main service page, and it leaves the sitemap contradicting the page. Remove the line. This gives 76 on its own. - **Image file missing:** `src/index.njk:8` uses ``. There is no `img` folder in the repo and `.eleventy.js` has no passthrough for one. Add the file and a passthrough copy, or the image will 404. ## Worth considering - **Enrich the Dentist structured data:** `src/contact.njk:10`: `"telephone": "0113 496 0000"`. The visible address (12 Park Row, Leeds), opening hours and `url` are already on the page or known. Adding them as `address` and `openingHours` might help machines quote them correctly. - **Back up "Our prices are simple and clear":** `src/services.njk:9`. No prices appear. List them as text. - **Give each treatment its own page:** `src/services.njk:8` `
  • Implants
    • `. Pages for implants, hygiene and so on would each get their own address and description. - **Name the dentists:** `src/team.njk:6` `decades of experience between them`. Add names, qualifications and registration details as text. - **Back up "Trusted by thousands of local patients":** `src/index.njk:7`. Add reviews or a source. - **Add opening hours and emergency contact details as text:** `src/contact.njk:7` gives only a phone number and an address, but the home page promises emergency appointments. - **Add `` to the sitemap:** `src/sitemap.xml:3`. Entries have only ``. Add dates, or generate the sitemap from Eleventy's collections instead of keeping it by hand. - **Add `Organization` or `WebSite` structured data and social tags:** `src/_includes/base.njk:3-9` has no `og:` tags or site identity. - **Link onward from the home page:** `src/index.njk:9` links only to Services. Add links to Team and Contact. - **Add a 404 page:** there is no `src/404.njk`, so wrong addresses have no real not-found page. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Server answers and headers:** real status codes, redirects and any `X-Robots-Tag` headers set at your host. A live scan with your URL would show these. ## Assumptions - You want AI search tools to find this site. `geo.config.json` says `aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"`. - The production origin is `https://www.brightside-dental.example`, from `geo.config.json` and the sitemap. - I read all 5 pages, the shared layout, `.eleventy.js`, robots.txt, the sitemap and the one JSON-LD source. I sampled 4 indexable routes. `/thanks/` is noindex on purpose and isn't in the sitemap. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-015`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
